name: Jhon990 Calculator Suite
author: jhon990

sections.description:
Jhon990 Calculator Suite is a complete calculator solution that you can add to your WordPress site via shortcode, widget, or Gutenberg block.

The plugin also includes an AMVGG Calculator, making it easy for users to access it alongside Basic, Scientific, Loan/EMI, BMI, Percentage, and Currency Converter calculators from a single interface.

Features

  • AMVGG Calculator
  • Basic Calculator
  • Scientific Calculator
  • Loan / EMI Calculator
  • BMI Calculator
  • Percentage Calculator
  • Currency Converter
  • Calculation History
  • Gutenberg Block Support
  • Widget Support
  • Shortcode Support
  • Admin Settings Page
  • Translation Ready
  • Lightweight
  • No External API Calls

Shortcode Usage

[jncs_calculator type="basic"]

[jncs_calculator type="scientific"]

[jncs_calculator type="loan"]

[jncs_calculator type="bmi"]

[jncs_calculator type="percentage"]

[jncs_calculator type="currency"]

[jncs_calculator type="all"]

Example:

[jncs_calculator type="basic" title="My Calculator" theme="#ff5733"]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Add the shortcode to any page or post.
  4. Configure the plugin under Settings → Calculator Suite.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin use external APIs?

No. Everything runs locally except the exchange rate you manually enter.

Does it include the AMVGG Calculator?

Yes.

Is it mobile friendly?

Yes.
